inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected Obsidian config/plugins, folder taxonomy, sample recipe, ratio note, technique note, and source/reference patterns

anchors.why: Shows active plugins: Obsidian Linter, LanguageTool, and Obsidian Git.
Large linter config controls heading style, list markers, bare URLs, footnotes, and many formatting rules.
Shows formula-like ingredient ratios relative to starter, ordered steps, mods, and resource links.
Shows reusable technique ratio table with one method and a water-ratio matrix.
Shows a small technique concept note with aliases.

known_limits: This is a personal Obsidian vault with minimal README context.
Recipe/resource links are not verified evidence packets.
Obsidian plugin settings are useful local practice, not a portable VAKS default.
